evidence.claim: Records 17, 18, 19, 20 reference slots beyond the record's own vertex list and no visibility list in either group names them.
Articulation axis and pivot follow the $8001 vertex terminator at $053B4A and are scaled by the structure X/Z factors $054D98 copies from the placing record's scale bytes.

model.name: Building detail 69
model.reason: Shape and structure-bound colours decoded. Both view-conditioned visibility groups are recovered, and every authored box list and group default is offered as its own inspection form because a free-orbit view has no player position to select one with. Records 17, 18, 19, 20 name shared vertex slots above this list, which $053D32 never fills, so they could only draw whatever the previous model left behind. No box list or group default selects them, so they are kept as selector ordinals and drawn by nothing. Articulated part. $054D98 installs the placing structure's X and Z scale bytes at $539CE/$539D2, $053B4A scales this record's pivot the same way, and $053D52 scales each vertex before $053D74 turns the tagged ones by $7888, so the turn belongs to the structure frame rather than to the model. Frames evidenced here: -2×2, 2×2, each offered at 8 sampled angles. $7888 free-runs, so no single frame of it is canonical.
